problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{3}$ are given below. Determine whether $B={{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}.$ If that is the case, find ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2},$ where ${a}_{3}={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 18\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 12\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
We want to determine if $B$ is indeed a basis of $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}.$ So, we want to find ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}\in R$ such that 

$$
{x}_{1}{{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{1}}+{x}_{2}{{[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 18\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{2}}={{[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 12\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{3}}.
$$

This equation is equivalent to the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+9{x}_{2}=-6 \\ 6{x}_{1}+18{x}_{2}=12\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we reduce the augmented matrix of the system to reduced row echelon form (RREF):

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,[\begin{aligned}3 & 9 & -6 \\ 6 & 18 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -2 \\ 6 & 18 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-6){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 24\end{aligned}] &  & \end{aligned}
$$

From the second row of the RREF matrix above, we see that the system of equations has no solution.

Therefore, ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ is not a basis of $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}.$
